note: Record of the steps after the automatic flow, in order. Coordinates are pump coordinates (cartgeom_a.py). Run from cart/a with ../../board/kpy; OP_LAYERS=6 for every router call. Freerouting is not deterministic, so a re-run gives a different routed board: the committed cart_a6.kicad_pcb is the source of truth and these steps document how it was closed. TEST PROJECT, water only.

OP_LAYERS=6 ./finish_cart_a.sh cart_a6_try6.kicad_pcb cart_a6_try6_placed.kicad_pcb cart_a6_try6_f1.kicad_pcb 10  (A*, rip-up greedy; best kept as .best)

gnd_stub_a.py <board> U1:G8 -> BUZ_A track G8 -> via (60.10, 33.76)

steps.result: APHASE and BUZ_A routed -> 0 signal opens, 0 errors (cart_a6_try6_h3)
